name: Wheat straw production process
notes:
Kim, T; Benavides, P.T.; Gradica, U.R.; Bamford, J. Life Cycle Greenhouse Gas Emissions, Water and Fossil-Fuel Consumption for Polyethylene Furanoate and its Co-Products from Lignocellulosic Biomass, ACS Sustainable Chemistry & Engineering, 2021, publication in preparation. 

This process includes 
1) upstream production for the material/energy inputs required for wheat straw farming (e.g., urea). 
2) decomposition emissions from the fertilizer (i.e., 6947gCO2/ton and 189gN2O/ton)
3) relative decomposition emissions from the wheat residue when straw is baled compared to the status-quo scenario (we assumed the "100% wheat straw baling" as the status-quo scenario, thus resulting in 0g GHG emissions from wheat straw management method).
